source_a.claim: Sealing is an account security measure using a 1,200 adena security scroll to lock an item against theft/trading.

source_b.claim: Sealing is the classic Lineage II state where dropped B/A grade armors drop as '(Sealed)' and must be unlocked at town Blacksmiths to activate full set stats.

resolution: These are two entirely separate systems sharing the word 'Seal'. System A is 'Security Item Lock'. System B is 'Classic Blacksmith Unsealing'. In Aden Arena, System B is adopted for equipment progression while System A is reserved for player inventory locking.

source_a.claim: Essence uses unified universal Soulshots and Spiritshots that work on all weapon grades (No-Grade to A-Grade), scaling only consumption per shot.

source_b.article: Lineage II Classic / Traditional Game Mechanics
source_b.claim: Shots are strictly grade-segregated (No-grade Soulshot, D-grade Soulshot, C-grade Soulshot, etc.) and cannot be loaded into non-matching grade weapons.

resolution: Lineage II Essence eliminated grade-specific shots to streamline inventory and auto-hunting. In Aden Arena Season 1, adopting Essence's unified shot mechanism reduces inventory clutter and eliminates friction during grade transitions.

source_a.claim: Failing an enchant on standard weapons/armor completely destroys the item into nothingness, unless protected by Blessed/Stable scrolls.

source_b.article: Lineage II Classic / Main Base Game
source_b.claim: Failing an enchant breaks the item into a predetermined quantity of Crystals and Gemstones matching the item's grade and enchant level.

resolution: Total item destruction without residual materials creates extreme player frustration in early-to-mid progression. Aden Arena resolves this by combining both: failed standard enchants destroy the gear but yield Gemstones and Crystals (Classic style) which feed into Collections and Soul Crystal insertion fees.

topic: L-Coin Store vs Eva's Shop Economy

source_a.claim: Premium economy relies on L-Coins as the central trading medium and store currency.

source_b.claim: Project Eva removes direct cash dependency by using Eva Points earned via in-game daily activity + Adena to buy core items (Runes, talismans).

resolution: For Aden Arena, Project Eva's philosophy is superior for an idle browser game: gameplay activity generates the secondary progression currency, preserving fairness.
